issues.detail: Non-breaking space (U+00A0) used as an empty-cell placeholder; read as a value by naive parsers, so those cells look populated when they are not.

issues.field: LakeDB_ID, Lat_lake, Lon_lake, Mechanism, Infra, Ref_other
issues.detail: Values padded with leading spaces, which breaks exact-match joins and grouping.
One record stores coordinates as ' 36.329250°' rather than a bare decimal, so it coerces to NaN and the event silently drops out of any map or spatial join.
issues.action: Stripped the symbol and parsed as float.

issues.detail: Lake coordinates span 27.56–45.08°N, 69.44–101.98°E. All fall inside High Mountain Asia.
Both fields are populated for 582 records and never disagree. Year_approx is a superset that additionally carries text forms such as 'Before 1966', '2002-2004' and '1960s'.
Ranges, decades and 'Before YYYY' forms in a field documented as INT. Any direct pd.to_numeric drops these events from time series.
issues.action: Parsed to a midpoint/bound in year_best with the assumption recorded in year_precision.

issues.detail: 148 of 766 events (19%) carry no year at all. These are mostly satellite-detected events with no documentary account. Any per-decade rate must state this denominator.
issues.action: Retained with year_precision='unknown'; excluded from time series by default.

issues.field: Lives_total, Livestock, Residential_destroyed, Commerical_destroyed, Residential_damaged, Commerical_damaged, Agricultural, Hydropower
issues.detail: Fields documented as INT contain prose such as 'Damage in 8 villages', '1200 Teesta III, 510 Teesta V, 500 Teesta VI' and '13 houses fully damaged; 10 partially damaged'. Summing these fields naively either errors or silently drops them.
issues.action: Numeric part set to NA and the original string preserved in a parallel <field>_note column.

issues.detail: '+' marks counts known only as a lower bound. The Data Description defines it, but it is inside the value rather than a separate field.

'Unnamed' and 'Unknown' are used interchangeably for nameless lakes and the split moved between releases (v3: 246 Unnamed / 106 Unknown; v4: 230 / 122). Name-based joins across versions break on this alone.
issues.action: Flagged in Lake_name_is_placeholder; not used as a join key.

issues.detail: Compound entries use both ';' and ',' as separators and vary in capitalisation ('Ice avalanche, water level rise' vs 'High temperatures; intense rainfall'), so 20 raw Driver_GLOF strings collapse to 15 distinct terms.
issues.action: Split on both delimiters into <field>_terms lists with normalised casing.

issues.detail: 87% of events have no identified trigger and 75% no identified breach mechanism. Driver frequencies are therefore proportions of a small documented subset, not of all GLOFs.
issues.action: No change; surfaced in the dashboard denominators.

issues.check: Same lake, same date, two records
issues.detail: Two records share an identical lake coordinate and date. These appear to be a linked pair (Upper and Lower Ngole Cho, Nepal, 16 Aug 2024) that drained together and were given one shared coordinate rather than a true duplicate — but confirm against the source before treating them as two independent events.

450 of 766 records (59%) are flagged as repeat events. The published abstract attributes 23% of all events to just three ephemeral ice-dammed lakes (Merzbacher, Khurdopin, Kyagar). Treating rows as independent events overstates the number of distinct hazard sites by roughly a factor of two.
issues.action: No change; the dashboard offers a one-record-per-lake view.

issues.check: Fields with no data at all
issues.field: Lives_disabilities, Injured_male, Injured_female, Injured_disabilities, Displaced_male, Displaced_female, Displaced_disabilities, Commerical_damaged
issues.detail: 8 disaggregation fields are entirely empty across all 766 records. The schema promises sex- and disability-disaggregated casualties that were never populated.
issues.action: Retained for schema stability; excluded from analysis.

issues.check: Fatality total reconciles to the published abstract
issues.detail: Lives_total sums to 8,996 across 28 events with a recorded death toll, matching the 8,996 figure in the v4 metadata abstract. But only 28 of 766 records (4%) carry any casualty figure, and two events (6,000 and 1,980 deaths) supply 89% of the total.
issues.action: No change; the concentration is shown explicitly rather than averaged away.

issues.check: GF_ID is not a stable identifier
issues.detail: GF_ID is reassigned at every release: of the 697 IDs present in both v1.0 and v4.0, only 16% refer to a record with the same lake coordinate. GF_ID 415 is a different flood in each version. Any stored reference to a GF_ID silently points at the wrong event after an update.
issues.action: Version diff matches on lake coordinate plus date instead of on GF_ID.
